ios.desc:
Dictly turns your voice into clean, styled text — entirely on-device.
Capture ideas, notes, or lists the moment they come to mind.
Works in any situation — no cloud, no telemetry, no connection required.


WHY DICTLY

• Private by design — everything happens locally on your iPhone or iPad.
• Instant feel — sub-100 ms first words with live preview and continuous updates.
• Styled as you speak — create Workflows that format text for messages, notes, or to-dos.
• Offline capable — works anywhere, even in airplane mode.


CORE FEATURES

• Real-time on-device transcription with contextual correction.
• Multi-language dictation — choose the language you speak in.
• Simple, focused recording interface for quick capture.
• Workflows — transform your text automatically into structured formats.
• Dictionary — add custom words and phrases for better recognition.
• History and Search — browse and reuse past transcriptions.
• Share and Export — copy, send to Notes or Files, or use the Share Sheet.


PRO FEATURES

• Unlimited Workflows — define prompts, styles, and variables to format your output.
• Unlimited Dictionaries — manage specialized vocabularies for different projects.
• Full History Access — see all your transcriptions.
• Advanced Sharing — export to multiple destinations.


PRIVACY

Dictly runs 100 percent on-device.
No servers. No analytics. No background uploads.
Your words never leave your iPhone or iPad unless you share them.


WORKS ANYWHERE

Dictly is built for mobility — capture thoughts instantly, even without signal.
Perfect for journaling, note-taking, task lists, or dictating ideas on the go.


PRICING

Free Core provides complete offline dictation with light limits.
Dictly Pro unlocks unlimited Workflows, Dictionaries, and Sharing.


Dictly makes typing optional — and your voice powerful.
Private. Instant. Offline.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

show_hn.title: Show HN: Dictly – Local, real‑time voice‑to‑text for macOS (sub‑100ms, no cloud)

quotes.text:
TL;DR: I built a native macOS dictation app that transcribes locally and instantly. 
Text appears as you speak (measured ~100 ms first‑character latency). 
No accounts, no servers, no tracking.

Links:
• Website: https://dictly.app
• Mac App Store: https://apps.apple.com/de/app/dictly-no-keys-just-clarity/id6752733596
• Free download; optional Pro tier (pipelines, unlimited history, etc.)

What it does

Real‑time transcription — streaming text while you talk, not after you stop.

Quick‑Capture Overlay (macOS) — global hotkey, drop text into any app/field.

Custom Pipelines — local post‑processing steps for cleanup, punctuation, or house style.

Dictionary Profiles — teach domain terms (names, brands, code tokens, etc.).

Local Analytics — see time saved vs typing (computed on device, never sent anywhere).

Why I built it

I wanted dictation that felt as immediate as typing and was trustworthy. Most tools stream audio to a server; I wanted something that never leaves the machine.

How it’s built (high‑level)

Swift + Apple speech/ML frameworks.
Streaming audio capture → on‑device recognition → local pipeline → paste into the active app.
Works with Wi‑Fi off; there are no network requests in the transcription path.

What’s different vs built‑ins

Always on‑device + streaming with a global overlay that works in any app.
Extensible, deterministic cleanup via pipelines (not a black‑box cloud).
Per‑project dictionaries to tame jargon and proper nouns.
